claims: National Burrito Day 2026 is on Thursday, April 2.
Chipotle's "Burrito Vault" game offers chances to win free burritos for a year.

Moe's Southwest Grill offers BOGO offer on burritos on National Burrito Day 2026.
El Pollo Loco offers BOGO a la carte burritos for rewards members on National Burrito Day 2026.
Bubbakoo's Burritos offers BOGO burrito offer (use code BURRITODAY online) on National Burrito Day 2026.
